saw_lines: Work shoes get bought when the pain gets bad enough, and buyers compare them to the pair they already own.
So the sale is won in the first line, where buyers decide if the pain is theirs.
Your site shows 3284 reviews and 100,000+ customers, yet only 5 of 30 ads carry the 100,000+ figure. Put it on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 31 Oct 2026
points: The site shows 100,000+ Happy Customers and 3284 reviews, yet only 5 of 30 ads carry 100,000+, and only in link text. Cold buyers need proof early. Put 100,000+ on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site explains how the shoes arrive, yet 0 of 30 ads say so. Buyers hesitate without that answer. Film one video of the box arriving at a clinic door, and open two more ads with the arrival line.
6 of 24 copy ads open on the same “antigrav1s have landed” line, while the rest are single use. Those 6 ads repeat the same first line. Test two new angles against it, on fit and on a customer story.

28 ads have run 60+ days, proof they work, so the next step is building on what already holds attention. Build three more variations of the oldest winner, each with a new opening line and a different product shot.

ads_1: Fresh openers on fit and arrival, with review numbers on every creative
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Youtube
